label: LUTs are cuts
subgoals: Implement each LUT as a K-feasible cut of a node
Require the leaves of every chosen cut to be mapped or primary inputs
Measure area as the LUT count and depth as the longest LUT chain

label: Labeling for minimum depth
subgoals: Label each AND node by its best cut: 1 plus the largest leaf label
Read the largest output label as the mapping depth

label: Depth gains and area recovery
subgoals: Compare the LUT depth with the AIG depth
Propagate required depths back from the outputs
Choose cheaper cuts on nodes with slack to recover area
